description: Mark a manufacturing production order Completed, exactly like the app's Complete button: deducts each BOM component's quantityActuallyUsed, adds quantityToProduce of the finished product, and logs inventory adjustments. Owner/admin/manager keys only. Rejects component stock going below zero unless allowNegative is true. Supports confirm (false = dry-run preview).

allowNegative.description: Allow component stock to go below zero (default false)

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

moNumber.description: Production order number, e.g. MO-0001 (or use orderId)

orderId.description: Production order document ID (or use moNumber)

name: complete_production_order
